headline: DeepSeek narrows US-China model gap to about 3%
body: Bloomberg Intelligence found DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash scored 81.1 on LiveBench against Anthropic's top 83.4, the smallest US-China gap it has tracked, down from about 15% earlier in 2026. More top-tier capability in more hands lowers Power Concentration, which lifts Libertarian Utopia and cuts Enslaved God and 1984; tighter rivalry also counts as a small minus for Global Coordination. Separately, the NYT reported that Anthropic lobbied Vatican advisers to soften the Church's position that AI systems are not conscious, a nudge toward Human-AI Merging that helps Descendants. Horizon Balance rose to -7.39.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.6, mostly from the narrowing DeepSeek gap (+0.48) and the Vatican report (+0.10). Enslaved God -0.5, from the narrowing DeepSeek gap (-0.48) and fading earlier news (-0.06). 1984 -0.4, from the narrowing DeepSeek gap (-0.46), partly offset by fading earlier news (+0.03).
